The '''Borgo Prime system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Oricho sector/Legends|Oricho sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Borgo Prime/Legends|Borgo Prime]].<ref name="YJK:SA" />
